Context: Procedural requirements for easy settlement of claims

## Procedural requirements for easy settlement of claims  
- (i) Submit your application for leave before LTC journey is undertaken.
- Check your eligibility before applying for LTC. A retiring Govern ment employee is eligible to avail LTC but the return journey
- (ii) should be completed before his date of retirement.
- (iii) Journey should be undertaken in your entitled class only.
- (iv) You can apply for an advance 65 days (125 days if journey is by train) before the proposed date of journey.
